title: American woman convicted of getting military training from Daesh group
description: NEW YORK: An American woman who joined the Daesh group before being caught by anti-Daesh forces in Syria was found guilty on Tuesday of receiving military training from the jihadists. Halima Salman, 27, was one of hundreds of foreign women who went or were taken to the territory controlled by the Daesh, and who then married jihadist fighters before being captured and detained pending their repatriation. title: Israel election: Record turnout as Netanyahu and Eisenkot remain deadlocked
description: Israel's election remained deadlocked on Tuesday, exit polls showed, with opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot's bloc narrowly ahead of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's camp by 52 seats to 50. Neither side had a clear path to forming a government. Voter turnout reached 77.7%, the highest in more than two decades.
